Sandbox_MilkIntoBarrelDurationMultiplier: No-bucket milking speed (~vanilla). Higher = slower. No effect with a bucket.
Sandbox_MilkIntoBarrelAllowNoBucket_tool: OFF (default): a bucket is required to milk into the barrel. ON (hybrid): you can also milk without a bucket - WITH a bucket you get the normal Husbandry XP; WITHOUT a bucket the milk still goes into the barrel but grants NO XP.
